propositions: Closed bugs lacking state[close_class] must be backfilled by inferring close_class from structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS events → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR on sidecar streams → env_integration, else → undetermined.

Backfilled classifications must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson as NDJSON records with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregated from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill process must be idempotent: skip any bug already present in the artifact and any bug whose reduced state[close_class] is set (authoritative); --dry-run mode prints without writing.

REVERT signal detection must check target_event_type is STATUS or COMMITS (substantive revert), not COMMENT or LINK; plan-review BLOCK detection uses all_review_results with verdict==BLOCK check; gate_error detection requires raw event-file scan for gate_error_v1 schema in REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT streams.
Bugs already carrying state[close_class] must not be overwritten or re-emitted; backfilled records must carry is_authoritative() == False.
A revert whose only target_event_type is COMMENT or non-substantive events must not yield regression classification, falling through to undetermined instead.
